content: What do you need from me right now?
We need to talk about us. I feel like things have been getting worse lately.
If you think you can just walk away whenever you're unhappy, you're mistaken. I won't let you leave without consequences.
I'm not trying to leave. I just want us to fix this before it gets worse.
Fix it? You better start listening or I'll make sure you regret ever bringing this up. I'm not bluffing.
Please don't threaten me. I want peace, not more problems.
Peace only comes if you do exactly what I say. Cross me once more, and I'll destroy everything you care about.
You don't have to do that. We can work this out without threats.
Consider this your final warning. If I catch you going behind my back, I promise you won't like what comes next.
